AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

Limitation.description: Limitation on the quantity of data returned and optional Cursor for the starting point of data.

EnterpriseIds.description: Unique identifiers of the Enterprises. If not specified, the operation returns data for all enterprises within scope of the Access Token.

CompanionshipIds.description: Unique identifiers of `Companionship`. Required if no other filter is provided.

Extent.title: Companionship extent
Extent.description: Extent of data to be returned. E.g. it is possible to specify that together with the companionships, customers, reservations, and reservation groups should be also returned.

ReservationIds.description: Unique identifiers of `Reservation`. Required if no other filter is provided.

CustomerIds.description: Unique identifiers of `Customer`. Required if no other filter is provided.

ReservationGroupIds.description: Unique identifiers of `ReservationGroup`. Required if no other filter is provided.

UpdatedUtc.title: Time interval
UpdatedUtc.description: Interval in which the `Companionship` was updated. Must be used together with at least one another filter.
